_comments: Recurring bills. The list lives under the "bills" key so this documentation block can
sit at the top of the file; the code also accepts a bare JSON array if you prefer.
Keys beginning with an underscore are ignored.
Each entry:
id .............. Stable slug. Never reuse or renumber — the diff on an uploaded
screenshot matches on this, and history is keyed to it.
name ............ Human-readable name. Shows up in the text message.
amount .......... Dollars, positive number.
due_day ......... Day of the month, 1-31. Used by monthly and semimonthly bills.
A day past the end of a short month clamps to the last day, so
31 lands on the 28th in February.
frequency ....... monthly | weekly | biweekly | semimonthly | annual | once
due_date ........ ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for 'once' and 'annual'. For
'annual' only the month and day are used.
anchor_date ..... ISO date. Required for 'weekly' and 'biweekly' — every occurrence
is counted forward from this date in 7- or 14-day steps.
autopay ......... true if it comes out on its own. A bill on a weekend is still
counted on its due date; nothing is shifted to the next weekday.
match_keywords .. Case-insensitive substrings used to spot this bill in the bank
feed, so a bill that already cleared is not subtracted twice.
active .......... false hides it from all projections without deleting the history.
An uploaded screenshot that omits a bill sets this to false; it
never deletes the entry.
needs_review .... Set automatically when an upload changes an amount by more than
40% or reads an amount above $10,000. The change is applied and
flagged in the confirmation text. Clear it by hand once checked.
note ............ Free text. Written automatically when a bill is deactivated.
last_updated .... ISO timestamp, written automatically.
source .......... 'manual' or 'screenshot'.
